title: HOA Fee Drift Threshold Alert
dataSources: Mortgage-rate snapshots (`mortgage:rate`), property-listing and Zestimate data (`property:listing`), HOA fees (`hoa:fee`), property-tax installments (`propertytax:installment`), home-buying milestones (`homebuying:milestone`).
app: Mortgage-rate watchers, Zestimate exports, HOA-fee logs, and property-tax installment trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and personal checklists.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hoa:fee
| eval metric=fee_amount_usd
| where metric>=450
| table _time association_name metric
| sort - _time
description: Flags records where hoa fee drift crossed a threshold you care about.
value: Threshold alerts are a practical way to turn slow property monitoring into timely action, whether the threshold is a rate, fee, or value band.
implementation: Set the threshold expression to match the trigger you actually care about before scheduling the search.
visualization: Exception table of threshold-crossing hoa fee drift records.
grandmaExplanation: It totals when hoa fee drift crosses a limit that matters to you.
